integrity: Complete finite face-enumeration and acyclic-matching proof with executable standard-library source; independent audit not performed. The separate mod-two check corroborates but does not replace the integral Morse argument.
scientific_limitations: Finite twelve-vertex graph only; no infinite-family homotopy formula. The full automorphism character is rational; its integral lattice decomposition is not asserted. Equivalent unindexed literature and full-text coverage of some indexed records remain possible.
title: Cuboctahedral two-independence: thirty-two three-spheres and the octahedral homology character
